# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 2: Act II Foundation of Nova Elysia — Senate, Constitution, Culture & Natives (oe_eln_, Slot 73). Generated by gen_elysia_nation.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. One-time Act II Nation initialization (never overwrites W3/W4 milestone flags).
oe_eln_ensure_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_init } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_init value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_months_settled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_senate_axis value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_foederati_pacts value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_limes_forts value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_migration_waves value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_american_locs value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col2_elysia_frontier_hook } }
			oe_col2_activate_elysia_hook = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Shift constitutional Senate axis (-100 Basileus .. +100 Res Publica) and clamp.
oe_eln_shift_senate_axis = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_senate_axis } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_senate_axis value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_eln_senate_axis add = $delta$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_eln_senate_axis min = -100 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. Cache count of owned locations in continent:america for telemetry & gating.
oe_eln_refresh_american_loc_count = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_eln_american_locs value = 0 }
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = { continent = continent:america }
		prev = { change_variable = { name = oe_eln_american_locs add = 1 } }
	}
}

# Country scope. Peaceful Roman Foederati diplomacy with Chesapeake & East Coast pop nations.
# Every c:TAG is strictly guarded by country_exists = c:TAG and country_type = pop.
oe_eln_apply_foederati_diplomacy = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_eln_host
	set_variable = { name = oe_col2_elysia_foederati_signed value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_foederati_pacts } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_foederati_pacts value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:NSM c:NSM = { country_type = pop } }
		c:NSM = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = friendly_natives } }
		add_truce_with = { target = c:NSM years = 15 mutual = yes }
		change_variable = { name = oe_eln_foederati_pacts add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:TSN c:TSN = { country_type = pop } }
		c:TSN = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = friendly_natives } }
		add_truce_with = { target = c:TSN years = 15 mutual = yes }
		change_variable = { name = oe_eln_foederati_pacts add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:RPP c:RPP = { country_type = pop } }
		c:RPP = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = opinion_good_relations } }
		add_truce_with = { target = c:RPP years = 15 mutual = yes }
		change_variable = { name = oe_eln_foederati_pacts add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:ACW c:ACW = { country_type = pop } }
		c:ACW = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = opinion_peaceful_trade_relations } }
		change_variable = { name = oe_eln_foederati_pacts add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:CAA c:CAA = { country_type = pop } }
		c:CAA = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = opinion_good_relations } }
		add_truce_with = { target = c:CAA years = 15 mutual = yes }
		change_variable = { name = oe_eln_foederati_pacts add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:PSC c:PSC = { country_type = pop } }
		c:PSC = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = opinion_peaceful_trade_relations } }
		change_variable = { name = oe_eln_foederati_pacts add = 1 }
	}
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				area = area:virginia_area
				area = area:maryland_area
				area = area:north_carolina_area
			}
		}
		add_location_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_eln_foederati_loc_mod
			years = 25
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Armed Potomac-Appalachian Limes frontier enforcement.
# Every c:TAG is strictly guarded by country_exists = c:TAG (IRO with STD/OSG fallback).
oe_eln_apply_limes_diplomacy = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_eln_host
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_limes_forts } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_limes_forts value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_eln_limes_forts add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:NSM c:NSM = { country_type = pop } }
		c:NSM = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = angry_natives } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:TSN c:TSN = { country_type = pop } }
		c:TSN = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = angry_natives } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:RPP c:RPP = { country_type = pop } }
		c:RPP = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = border_friction_from_event } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:CAA c:CAA = { country_type = pop } }
		c:CAA = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = border_friction_from_event } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:PSC c:PSC = { country_type = pop } }
		c:PSC = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = border_friction_from_event } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:IRO }
		c:IRO = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = border_aggression } }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:STD c:STD = { country_type = pop } }
			c:STD = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = border_aggression } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:OSG c:OSG = { country_type = pop } }
			c:OSG = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = border_aggression } }
		}
	}
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				area = area:virginia_area
				area = area:maryland_area
				area = area:north_carolina_area
			}
		}
		add_location_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_eln_limes_march_loc_mod
			years = 25
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Native EU5 1.4.9 add_migration frontier wave from Chesapeake core to owned expansion provinces.
oe_eln_frontier_migration_wave = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_eln_host
	if = {
		limit = { oe_eln_has_chesapeake_core = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_migration_waves } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_migration_waves value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location:powhatan = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_host }
					location:pamunkey = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_host }
				}
			}
			add_migration = {
				owner = scope:oe_eln_host
				from = province_definition:chesapeake_province
				to = province_definition:powhatan_province
				type = pop_type:peasants
				amount = 0.25
				months = 24
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_eln_migration_waves add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location:roanoke = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_host }
					location:croatan = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_host }
				}
			}
			add_migration = {
				owner = scope:oe_eln_host
				from = province_definition:chesapeake_province
				to = province_definition:roanoke_province
				type = pop_type:peasants
				amount = 0.20
				months = 24
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_eln_migration_waves add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				location:anacostia = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_host }
			}
			add_migration = {
				owner = scope:oe_eln_host
				from = province_definition:chesapeake_province
				to = province_definition:potomac_province
				type = pop_type:peasants
				amount = 0.20
				months = 24
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_eln_migration_waves add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				location:patapsco = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_host }
			}
			add_migration = {
				owner = scope:oe_eln_host
				from = province_definition:chesapeake_province
				to = province_definition:patapsco_province
				type = pop_type:burghers
				amount = 0.15
				months = 24
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_eln_migration_waves add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				location:manhattan = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_host }
			}
			add_migration = {
				owner = scope:oe_eln_host
				from = province_definition:chesapeake_province
				to = province_definition:manhattan_province
				type = pop_type:burghers
				amount = 0.20
				months = 24
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_eln_migration_waves add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Execute Elysian Greek (oe_elysian_greek) ethnogenesis cleanly.
# Keeps greek_culture as accepted; shifts American Greek pops; boosts cultural_tradition in culture scope.
oe_eln_execute_ethnogenesis = {
	change_culture = culture:oe_elysian_greek
	add_accepted_culture = culture:greek_culture
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = { continent = continent:america }
		every_pop = {
			limit = { culture = culture:greek_culture }
			change_pop_culture = culture:oe_elysian_greek
		}
	}
	culture = {
		add_cultural_tradition = 12
		add_cultural_influence = 10
	}
	set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ethnogenesis_done value = 1 }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Slot 73 Mainline Entry Point: oe_eln_monthly
# Called on Nova Elysia country once per month after oe_ely_settled is set.
# NOTE (Cross-Worker Contract): W3 (v105/w3-faith-mil) dispatches Act II faith
# & military events oe_eln.3-oe_eln.11 via its own rebel-guarded monthly pulse
# (in_game/common/on_action/oe_eln_faith_mil_pulse.txt) gated on
# has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled + has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia,
# keeping W2 and W3 zero-coupling with 0 undefined cross-branch references.
# ==============================================================================
oe_eln_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_eln_is_elysia = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_tick_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_tick_cd days = 25 }
		oe_eln_ensure_init = yes
		change_variable = { name = oe_eln_months_settled add = 1 }
		oe_eln_refresh_american_loc_count = yes

		# Periodic frontier migration wave when Asylum or Foederati policy is enacted (bare key!)
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_mig_cd }
				OR = {
					has_policy = oe_eln_pol_open_asylum
					has_policy = oe_eln_pol_foederati_civitas
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_mig_cd days = 1080 }
			oe_eln_frontier_migration_wave = yes
		}

		# Act II Nation event dispatcher (max 1 event per month)
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev1_fired }
				var:oe_eln_months_settled >= 24
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ev1_fired value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev2_fired }
				has_variable = oe_eln_senate_convened
				var:oe_eln_months_settled >= 36
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ev2_fired value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev16_fired }
				oe_eln_has_cash_crop_hub = yes
				var:oe_eln_months_settled >= 72
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ev16_fired value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.16
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev14_fired }
				oe_eln_is_foederati_path = yes
				var:oe_eln_months_settled >= 96
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ev14_fired value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.14
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev15_fired }
				oe_eln_is_limes_path = yes
				var:oe_eln_months_settled >= 96
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ev15_fired value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.15
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev17_fired }
				oe_eln_has_northern_hub = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ev17_fired value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.17
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev18_fired }
				oe_eln_has_southern_hub = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ev18_fired value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.18
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev13_fired }
				has_variable = oe_eln_senate_convened
				var:oe_eln_months_settled >= 180
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ev13_fired value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.13
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev12_fired }
				oe_eln_ready_for_ethnogenesis = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ev12_fired value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.12
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev19_fired }
				oe_eln_ready_for_consolidation = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_ev19_fired value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.19
		}
	}
}
